description: Representative Maria Elvira Salazar (R-FL) discusses why she doesn’t support the War Powers Act and shares her thoughts on the US-Israel strikes on Iran. She also talks about whether or not she will support supplemental funding and why she believes President Trump should intervene with Cuba. Representative Salazar speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: 'Cuba is the Mothership of Evil:' Rep. Maria Salazar

author: Lucy White
description: More than 100 Labour Party lawmakers have urged Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s government to rethink changes to the UK’s immigration system, underscoring the scale of opposition confronting him from within his own ranks.
title: Starmer Facing Revolt on UK Immigration Reforms From 100 MPs

author: Heesu Lee, Sangmi Cha, Abhishek Vishnoi
description: Lee Jae Myung championed a revamped South Korean stock market as a new builder of household wealth on his road to victory in the presidential election last June – an initiative that looked to be going fantastically well as of last week.
title: South Korean President’s Big Bet on Stocks Risks Backfiring

description: Dana Stroul, Research Director at The Washington Institute for Near East Policy and former assistant deputy secretary of state for the Middle East under the Biden Administration, weighs in on the next phase of U.S.-Israel strikes on Iran. She outlines the effort to eliminate missile and naval threats, warns of the risks of arming Kurdish forces, and questions whether air power alone can achieve regime change. Stroul speaks with Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s Balance of Power. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stroul Questions US Endgame in Expanding Iran Campaign

description:
On the Big Take podcast, former Secretary of State Antony Blinken discusses how war in Iran leaves the US exposed and the two factors that could bring about a ceasefire.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Big Take: Antony Blinken On Two Keys To Ending War In Iran

author: David Gura, David Fox
description: On today’s Big Take podcast, former Secretary of State Antony Blinken discusses how war in Iran leaves the US exposed and the two factors that could push President Trump towards a ceasefire.
title: Antony Blinken Spent Years Trying to Avoid War With Iran. What He Says Could End It Now

author: Zoe Tillman
description: A federal appeals court has for now shielded billionaire Elon Musk from being questioned under oath about his role last year in shuttering the US Agency for International Development.
title: Elon Musk Deposition Blocked by Appeals Court in DOGE Fight

author: Jamie Tarabay, Steven T. Dennis, Roxana Tiron
description: The US Senate cleared the way for President Donald Trump to continue military attacks on Iran in a vote Wednesday that starkly demonstrated the nation’s deep divisions as it goes to war in a volatile region.
title: US Senate Clears Way for Trump on Iran War Despite Stark Divide

author: Stephan Kueffner
description: Ecuador expelled the entire staff of the Cuban embassy in the latest rupture between Quito and leftist governments in the region.
title: Ecuador Expels Entire Cuban Embassy Staff Ahead of Trump Summit

description: President Donald Trump expressed confidence in the US military campaign against Iran even as the timeline for operations remained deeply unclear on the fifth day of the Middle East war. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Doing ‘Very Well’ as Middle East War Shakes Region

author: Mark Chediak
description: White House compact seeks to have companies pay for data center power draw.
title: Trump Hopes Tech Pledges Can Sooth Voters’ Electricity Bill Angst

author: Jamie Tarabay, Steven T. Dennis
description: When US President Donald Trump joined Israel in launching a military operation against Iran, pulverizing Iranian government installations and killing Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, he did so without seeking congressional authorization.
title: Does Trump Need Congress to Wage War on Iran?

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: The Iranian warship IRIS Dena was in the Indian Ocean when a Los Angeles-class US attack submarine fired an MK-48 torpedo, setting off a massive explosion that lifted the ship’s stern out of the water before sinking the vessel.
title: Iran’s Navy in Crosshairs as US Strikes Warship With Submarine

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy, Courtney Subramanian
description: President Donald Trump declared the public would benefit from a commitment by the nation’s largest tech companies to defray electricity costs related to artificial intelligence development — but it might take a while.
title: Trump Vows Data-Center Pledge Will Eventually Cut Power Costs

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss the latest Fed Beige Book showing a weaker consumer with Bloomberg News Economics Editor Molly Smith. Then, Alli McCartney of UBS Alignment Partners weighs in on the trade as stocks rise off the back of better-than-expected ISM data, as Wall Street looks for a "Trump put" related to the Iran war. Then, Bloomberg News National Security Team Leader Nick Wadhams on the current state of US military action in Iran and the surrounding region. Finally, Bloomberg News Consumer Tech Reporter Samantha Kelly on Apple's new $599 MacBook Neo. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stocks Higher on ISM, Apple's Cheaper MacBook | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 3/04/2026

description: Nick Wadhams, Bloomberg News National Security Team Leader, talks about what President Donald Trump hopes to accomplish in the war with Iran and why the White House says it had to attack first.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: What Is the End Game for Trump in Iran War?

author: Zoe Tillman, Erik Larson
description: A US judge has ordered the Trump administration halt a key step in the tariff payment process in order to make any refunds simpler after the US Supreme Court struck down the president’s global tariffs.
title: Judge Orders US to Stop Calculating IEEPA Tariffs in Refund Push

author: Erik Wasson
description: The House committee investigating Jeffrey Epstein voted to subpoena US Attorney General Pam Bondi to testify on her handling of Justice Department files on the disgraced financier.
title: Pam Bondi Subpoenaed by House Panel to Testify on Epstein Files

author: Maggie Eastland
description: A bipartisan group of six US senators pressed Intel Corp. for more information about its relationship with ACM Research Inc., a maker of semiconductor equipment whose subsidiaries remain on a Commerce Department blacklist, following a 2024 listing for national security reasons.
title: US Senators Press Intel Over Ties to Firm With Sanctioned Units

author: Magdalena Del Valle, David Gura
description: Real change in Iran will require a sustained US military focus in the Middle East that could wear down US weapons stockpiles and leave it vulnerable to attacks from other adversaries such as Russia and China, former Secretary of State Antony Blinken said.
title: Sustained Iran War Effort May Leave US Vulnerable, Ex-Secretary of State Blinken Says

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Kailey Leinz discusses the ongoing war in Iran. On today's show, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Bluestack Strategies Founder Maura Gillespie, Amazon Vice President of Worldwide Economic Development Policy Holly Sullivan and former US Central Command Commander Gen. Kenneth "Frank" McKenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Says It Will Strike Iran Harder | Balance of Power: Early Edition 3/04/2026

author: Joe Lovinger
description: James Talarico’s victory over Jasmine Crockett in the race for the Democratic nomination for Senate in Texas came as a surprise to many poll watchers. Prediction-market traders never had much doubt.
title: Prediction Markets Picked Texas Democratic Primary Winner But Missed on GOP Race

description: President Donald Trump says he'll endorse a candidate in the Republican primary race to win a US Senate seat. Trump says a drawn out battle could hurt the party. Texas Bureau Chief Julie Fine reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Will Make Endorsement in Texas Race for US Senate Seat

author: Myles Miller
description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem faced a barrage of misconduct allegations before the House Judiciary Committee on Wednesday, including about her living arrangements, a blocked watchdog, a no-bid contract awarded to a newly established company, delayed hurricane relief and a Coast Guard pilot allegedly fired over a misplaced blanket.
title: Kristi Noem Grilled Over Housing, Relationship With Lewandowski

author: Katy O'Donnell
description: A powerful group representing the nation’s home builders is coming out against the most significant housing legislation in more than a decade over a provision negotiated by the White House that would restrict institutional investors from purchasing single-family homes.
title: Builders Oppose Senate Housing Bill Over Investor Ban Provision

author: Jim Wyss
description: Cuba suffered a massive blackout Wednesday, with the electrical grid that stretches across about two-thirds of the country collapsing amid an intensifying US push to deprive the government in Havana of fuel and financing.
title: Power Goes Out Across Much of Cuba as Havana’s Woes Mount

description: Can war bets on prediction markets like Polymarket offer price signals to the enemy? Bloomberg Opinion columnist Paul J. Davies explains the risk. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Betting on War Is a National Security Risk

author: Maya Davis
description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul slipped in a poll, conceding six points to Republican challenger Bruce Blakeman as the gubernatorial race tightens slightly.
title: New York Governor’s Race Narrows But Hochul Still Has Strong Lead

author: Anthony Halpin
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin said his country will consider ending most sales of natural gas to Europe in favor of more promising alternative markets.
title: Putin Says Russia to Weigh Redirecting Gas Supplies Away From EU

author: Josh Sisco, Ilena Peng
description: The Justice Department has been investigating whether several leading producers of commercial fertilizers colluded to raise prices, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: DOJ Probes US Fertilizer Market for Possible Price Fixing

author: Christopher Condon
description: President Donald Trump has formally nominated Kevin Warsh to serve as chair of the Federal Reserve’s Board of Governors, the White House said Wednesday in a statement.
title: Warsh Nominated for Fed Chair, Path to Confirmation Unclear

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: Interim President Delcy Rodriguez told mining executives and metals traders that Venezuela would move at “Trump speed” to help them unlock the South American nation’s mineral wealth.
title: Venezuela Says It Will Move Quickly to Unlock Mineral Wealth

author: Skylar Woodhouse, Paul Wallace, Galit Altstein, Eltaf Najafizada
description: President Donald Trump expressed confidence in the US military campaign against Iran even as the timeline for operations remained deeply unclear on the fifth day of the Middle East war.
title: Trump Says US Doing ‘Very Well’ as Iran War Shakes Region

author: Jess Shankleman, Mitchell Ferman
description: UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Rachel Reeves backtracked on plans to scrap a controversial windfall tax on North Sea oil and gas, after prices spiked because of the conflict in Iran.
title: War Forces Reeves To Keep North Sea Windfall Tax In Place

author: Cailley LaPara
description: The US Postal Service is bringing on restructuring advisers to help it address mounting financial problems that officials say could leave the agency out of cash within a year.
title: US Postal Service Taps Restructuring Firm Amid Cash Crunch

author: Gregory Korte
description: The Trump administration is proposing the biggest change to its employee retention rules in decades, attempting to substitute job performance for seniority in deciding who’s fired when an agency institutes layoffs.
title: Trump Plan Would Tie Federal Employee Layoffs to Performance

author: Jim Wyss
description: A tentative step by Cuba’s government to loosen its grip on the island’s economy as it struggles to provide basic services was met with tighter restrictions from President Donald Trump’s administration.
title: US, Cuba Make Competing Policy Tweaks as Island Suffers Blackout

author: Denitsa Tsekova
description: Polymarket opened more than a dozen new contracts tied to the Iran conflict since Saturday, including bets on regime change and Houthi strikes on Israel, as geopolitical wagers hit a record.
title: Prediction Markets Roll Out New War Bets Beyond Washington’s Reach

author: Joe Lovinger, Josh Wingrove
description: Three Texas Republicans fought a bruising primary race to claim a US Senate seat, only to see Tuesday’s election force two of them — Senator John Cornyn and Attorney General Ken Paxton — into a costly runoff.
title: Trump Says Texas Republican Battle Must End for Senate Win

author: Ram Anand
description: Malaysia’s anti-graft agency is investigating alleged abuse of power, fraud and governance issues linked to a deal between the government and Arm Holdings Plc, AFP reported.
title: Anti-Graft Agency Probes Malaysia’s Deal with Softbank’s Arm, AFP Reports

author: Mike Dorning, David Scheer
description: The congressional committee investigating disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein is seeking transcribed interviews with Microsoft Corp. co-founder Bill Gates and Apollo Global Management co-founder Leon Black.
title: Bill Gates, Leon Black Testimony Sought for Epstein Probe
